data.body: AC amendment: Test for finding hash normalization fields (line_range/cited_lines) — the test for finding identity documentation (Test 4) should match either 'line_range' or 'cited_lines' as the field name, since the workflow may use the existing 'cited_lines' field name from reviewer-findings.json schema. Pattern: grep for '(file.*line_range|file.*cited_lines|finding_hash|category)' when asserting finding identity normalization documentation is present.
